content.short: Zharta is a structured credit protocol providing fixed-rate lending backed by NFTs and real-world assets.
content.description:
Zharta is a premier decentralized finance protocol designed to provide professional-grade lending and borrowing solutions backed by tokenized assets. Originally an NFT-backed lending platform, the protocol has evolved into a comprehensive structured credit layer that supports a wide range of digital assets including NFTs and real-world assets (RWAs). Zharta utilizes a peer-to-pool model to offer users fixed-rate loans with predictable funding costs and zero risk of liquidation before the official loan maturity date.

Operating primarily on the Ethereum network, Zharta provides institutional and retail participants with a robust framework for capital liquidity. The platform focuses on high-transparency and secure on-chain execution, featuring professional-grade risk management and automated appraisal tools. Through its commitment to financial innovation and user sovereignty, Zharta is building the essential infrastructure for a more efficient and interconnected global credit system, where decentralized capital can safely power real-world growth.
